:::{#def-ellipse}
#### Ellipse

For two [points](#def-real-coordinate-space) $\vu$ and $\vv$ in the [real plane](#def-real-coordinate-space) $\reals^2$
and a number $s > \norm{\vu - \vv}$,
the **ellipse**
[@wikipedia_ellipse]
with foci $\vu$ and $\vv$
is the [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-set) of points in $\reals^2$
whose [Euclidean distances](#def-euclidean-distance) to $\vu$ and to $\vv$ add up to $s$:

$$\cb{\vx \in \reals^2 : \norm{\vx - \vu} + \norm{\vx - \vv} = s}$$

:::
